title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) für den Technischen Außendienst mit Vertriebstätigkeiten
description: Baustellen, Großevents und Schwertransporte zerstören Landschaft, Natur und Boden? Bei uns nicht! Sogar den Bau eines Olympiastadions haben wir mit unseren Bodenschutzsystemen ermöglicht. Aber auch für empfindliche Moorgebiete und Kulturstätten sind wir bestens gerüstet. Seit über 50 Jahren bieten wir unseren unterschiedlichen Kunden erfolgreich vielfältige Möglichkeiten für herausfordernde Bodenschutzprojekte. Wer das alles möglich macht? Unsere über 350 Expert/innen in 70 Crews, die in enger Zusammenarbeit täglich das Unmögliche möglich machen. title: Subsea Engineer
description: Purpose To ensure that the offshore subsea equipment spread is operated and maintained in an efficient, organised, and controlled manner in accordance with manufacturer operating manuals and project procedures. Carry out engineering duties within the back deck / subsea department, supporting the subsea team under the direction of the senior subsea lead. Develop technical knowledge and operational awareness to become fully conversant with the senior subsea engineer role. Operate as part of the vessel crew and work under the overall authority of the Vessel Master in line with vessel command structure. Duties & Responsibilities The Subsea Engineer shall: Uphold project safety and environmental policies and ensure defects, incidents, near misses, and non-conformances are reported and investigated in line with applicable procedures. Ensure that subsea personnel and technicians work in accordance with safe systems of work, including risk assessments and control measures prior to task execution. Support supervision and coordination of subsea department personnel, maintaining discipline and compliance with applicable maritime codes of conduct. Participate in vessel emergency response duties and drills as per the Muster List. Assist with inspection, testing, and basic maintenance of vessel safety systems, including fire detection and alarm systems where required. Take responsibility for safe and efficient operation of subsea systems when acting in a supervisory capacity or in the absence of the senior subsea lead. Demonstrate full understanding of senior subsea engineer responsibilities, including launch and recovery of subsea assets and operational decision-making offshore. Ensure subsea systems are operated within approved operational and insurance limitations. Manage subsea systems during maintenance, refurbishment, or standby periods. Coordinate subsea team activities including work allocation and watchkeeping in supervisory scenarios. Support planning and execution of maintenance, repair, and overhaul of subsea equipment to ensure operational readiness at all times. Escalate system downtime or reduced functionality to vessel leadership and onshore management where required. Assist with reporting, documentation, and technical returns for subsea systems. Maintain awareness of operational factors including vessel manoeuvrability, weather conditions, currents, and seabed characteristics. Support training and development of junior technicians and subsea personnel. Undertake additional duties within the subsea engineering discipline as required by vessel or project management. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Pessoa Analista de Folha de Pagamento Pleno
description: Descrição da Vaga Vaga afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) Esta oportunidade de trabalho está aberta a qualquer pessoa, independentemente de religião, cor, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero. O CIEDS é contra qualquer forma de discriminação e está comprometido com inclusão, diversidade e igualdade de oportunidades. Caso acredite que possa se beneficiar da nossa política de ação afirmativa, pedimos que informe essa condição em sua candidatura. Desafios Buscamos uma Pessoa Analista de Folha de Pagamento Pleno com atuação generalista em Departamento Pessoal e sólida experiência nos processos de folha, encargos sociais e obrigações acessórias. O principal desafio da posição será garantir a correta execução da folha de pagamento, assegurando a conformidade das informações prestadas ao eSocial, DCTFWeb, FGTS Digital e demais órgãos fiscalizadores, mitigando riscos trabalhistas e previdenciários para a instituição. Além da atuação técnica em folha e encargos, o profissional deverá apoiar e acompanhar as demais rotinas de Administração de Pessoal, incluindo admissões, férias, rescisões, afastamentos, controle de jornada, benefícios e atendimento aos colaboradores. Espera-se uma postura analítica e proativa na identificação de inconsistências, revisão de processos, implementação de melhorias e apoio à gestão da área. A posição exige capacidade de atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, compartilhando conhecimento, apoiando profissionais menos experientes e contribuindo para a construção de processos mais eficientes, seguros e alinhados à legislação vigente. Também fará parte da missão do cargo participar de projetos de automação, integração de sistemas e aprimoramento dos controles internos da área de Departamento Pessoal. Principais Responsabilidades Processar, conferir e validar a folha de pagamento mensal, férias, 13º salário, rescisões e folhas complementares, garantindo a correta aplicação da legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e tributária; Realizar o fechamento e a conferência dos encargos sociais, incluindo INSS, FGTS Digital, IRRF e contribuições correlatas, assegurando a consistência dos valores e o cumprimento dos prazos legais; Administrar e monitorar os eventos do eSocial, promovendo a correta transmissão das informações e atuando na identificação, análise e regularização de inconsistências; Executar e acompanhar as obrigações acessórias da área, tais como DCTFWeb, FGTS Digital e demais declarações relacionadas à folha de pagamento; Atuar de forma generalista nas rotinas de Departamento Pessoal, apoiando os processos de admissão, férias, afastamentos previdenciários, controle de jornada, benefícios e rescisões; Realizar análises e conciliações entre folha de pagamento, encargos, provisões e informações contábeis, garantindo a integridade dos dados e apoiando os processos de fechamento mensal; Prestar suporte técnico às áreas internas, gestores e colaboradores em temas relacionados à legislação trabalhista, folha de pagamento e administração de pessoal; Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fiscalizações e processos de compliance, fornecendo informações, relatórios e documentações necessárias; Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e padronização dos processos de Departamento Pessoal, contribuindo para o aumento da eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos; Atuar como referência técnica da equipe, compartilhando conhecimento, apoiando profissionais menos experientes e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento contínuo da área; Elaborar indicadores, controles e relatórios gerenciais relacionados à folha de pagamento, encargos e obrigações legais, apoiando a tomada de decisão da gestão. Diferencial Conhecimento em automação de processos será considerado diferencial, especialmente utilização de Power Query, VBA, AppScript, Google Sheets e ferramentas de inteligência artificial aplicadas ao Departamento Pessoal. Requisitos Escolaridade: Graduação; Nível: Pleno; Excel; Google Sheets; Power Query; VBA (Visual Basic for Applications); AppScript. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Bijbaan International Tax in Amsterdam
description: Als jij het in je hebt, krijg je bij Grant Thornton meteen alle ruimte. Om je talent te laten zien. Om baanbrekend werk te verzetten voor toonaangevende klanten. Of het nu gaat om belastingadvies, (duurzame) verslaglegging, cybersecurity of impactdashboards: we willen dat jij impact maakt. Want bij ons draait het om jou: niet alleen kun je helemaal jezelf zijn, maar je wordt vanaf het begin serieus genomen. Je draait volop mee, met de verantwoordelijkheid die daarbij hoort en de juiste begeleiding. Jij krijgt de kans je potentieel meteen te laten zien. Onze unieke cultuur creëert een omgeving waarin je je empowered voelt om die extra stap te zetten. En we moedigen diversiteit en inclusie aan zodat iedereen zich bij ons thuis voelt. In jouw bijbaan Tax bij Grant Thornton duik je in de wereld van internationale belastingen. Je ondersteunt je collega’s bij het voorbereiden van adviezen over internationale belastingvraagstukken. Je helpt mee met het uitwerken van vaktechnische onderwerpen en stelt eenvoudige aangiften vennootschapsbelasting op. Zo doe je waardevolle praktijkervaring op in een internationale omgeving, terwijl je jezelf stap voor stap ontwikkelt naast je studie. Je zet jouw eerste stappen in de wereld van International Tax en groeit elke dag een stukje verder in het vak. Samen met ervaren collega’s werk je aan internationale fiscale vraagstukken voor klanten in allerlei sectoren, van gaming tot de dienstensector. Daarbij krijg je de begeleiding én ruimte die je nodig hebt om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je leert niet alleen hoe je klanten het beste kunt adviseren, maar ontdekt ook hoe leuk het is om samen te werken met collega’s van internationale kantoren. Zo combineer je praktijkervaring met klantcontact en bouw je stap voor stap aan een stevige basis voor je toekomst. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit: Opstellen van (eenvoudige) aangiften vennootschapsbelasting; Assisteren bij het opstellen van internationale belastingadviezen; Voorbereiden en uitwerken van internationale fiscale vraagstukken; Coördineren van btw-registraties en klantvragen in diverse landen; Ondersteunen van collega's bij complexe belastingvraagstukken. Wat neem je mee? Je volgt een wo-master Fiscaal recht of Fiscale economie, of hebt deze afgerond; Je bent minimaal 3 maanden beschikbaar, met een inzet van ten minste 2 dagen per week; Je hebt affiniteit met international tax en bent enthousiast om te leren; Je werkt accuraat, systematisch en integer; Je bent communicatief vaardig in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Over het team Werken bij International Tax Services (ITS) betekent werken in een enthousiast, levendig en divers team van 20 collega’s. Vanaf dag één draai je mee op grote internationale klantdossiers. Je krijgt snel verantwoordelijkheid, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. De lijnen zijn kort, ook met partners, en je werkt samen met verschillende collega’s, niet alleen je Development Manager. Dankzij wekelijkse vaktechnische overleggen, 1-op-1 begeleiding en de mogelijkheid tot internationale secondments, groei je snel in je rol én als mens. Je werkt op ons kantoor in Amsterdam, verdeeld over twee open verdiepingen met uitzicht op de Johan Cruijff ArenA en de Ziggo Dome. Een inspirerende plek waar je samenwerkt met collega’s uit alle disciplines aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Wat bieden wij jou? Jouw carrière. Jouw keuze. Bij Grant Thornton krijg je de ruimte om te ontdekken, te groeien en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je wordt actief begeleid door een mentor en werkt in een omgeving waar persoonlijke aandacht en professionele groei centraal staan. We geloven in vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid zodat jij het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. Salaris van € 18,29 per uur, inclusief vakantietoeslag; Begeleiding door een Development Manager waar je altijd terecht kunt. Grant Thornton is een netwerkorganisatie van wereldniveau. Internationaal zijn we één van de grootste accountants- en adviesorganisaties, een zevende plek wereldwijd! Hier in Nederland hebben we de fantastische voordelen van een kleinere organisatie met open cultuur, met de internationale mogelijkheden en multiculturele ervaring van één van de grootste organisaties ter wereld. Wij gaan altijd een stapje verder. Voor onze klanten en vooral ook voor jou. Zodat jij de allerbeste werkomgeving hebt, die inclusief is en waar we flink bezig zijn met duurzaamheid. We werken voor profit- én non-profitorganisaties. Specialiseer je zoals jij wilt en werk zo iedere dag aan een wereld die past bij jouw idealen en doelen. Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek hoe jij kunt groeien én bijdragen bij Grant Thornton! Meer weten over deze rol of werken bij Grant Thornton? Anne Baas of ) staat klaar om je verder te helpen. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Access Management Cluster Manager
description: Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. The Position Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well-planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location. Key Responsibilities Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites. Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. Your Profile Education Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience Experience with the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements Fluent in Portuguese and English. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Teya Senior Machine Learning Engineer you will build models and decision systems that turn Teya's data into better outcomes for our customers and our business. You will work in the AI Research & Development team partnering with engineers, product managers, and domain experts to take problems from framing through model development and into reliable, monitored production systems. Responsibilities Frame ambiguous business problems as well-posed modeling, inference, or optimization tasks, and choose methods that fit the data and the decision. Design, build, validate, and deploy predictive and decisioning models across areas such as fraud and risk monitoring, customer onboarding and due diligence, pricing, and customer lifetime value. Run rigorous experiments and causal analyses, including A/B testing, uplift modeling, and offline evaluation, to measure whether models actually move the outcomes that matter. Engineer features and build the data pipelines that feed training and serving, with attention to leakage, reproducibility, and data quality. Productionise models with strong attention to validation, backtesting, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining, so performance holds up after launch. Work closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to identify where modeling creates value and to integrate models into products and operational workflows. Apply optimization and operations research methods where decisions, not just predictions, are the goal. Contribute to modeling standards, evaluation practices, and reusable tooling across the team. Stay current with developments in machine learning and statistics, and apply new methods where they earn their place. Requirements Strong foundations in statistics and machine learning, with the judgment to match methods to problems. Proficiency in Python and its data and ML ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), and strong SQL. Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in production, not only in notebooks. Solid command of supervised and unsupervised learning, including methods such as gradient boosting, regularised regression, and clustering, with a clear understanding of model evaluation and overfitting. Experience with experimentation and inference, including A/B testing and the basics of causal estimation. Experience with cloud platforms and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, APIs, monitoring, infrastructure as code). Strong software engineering fundamentals including testing, reproducibility, and maintainability. Ability to communicate quantitative findings and their business implications clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Nice to have Experience building models in regulated industries such as payments, fintech, banking, risk, compliance, or fraud prevention. Experience with use cases such as: Fraud detection and anomaly detection Credit and onboarding risk decisioning Pricing and customer lifetime value modeling Churn and propensity modeling Forecasting and time series Recommendation and personalisation Background in operations research, mathematical programming, or stochastic optimization. Knowledge of MLOps, model lifecycle management, feature stores, monitoring, and governance. Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow where the problem warrants them. Familiarity with data engineering concepts, analytics platforms, and experimentation frameworks. Contributions to the ML or statistics community through open source, research, or technical writing. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. Com 130 mil colaboradores, temos o propósito de oferecer alimentação acessível e de qualidade a todos, enquanto contribuímos para uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável. No Carrefour, trabalhamos diariamente a cultura do respeito e da equidade. A valorização da diversidade é um compromisso para o Carrefour, por isso, encorajamos a candidatura e damos oportunidade a profissionais diversos, sejam Mulheres, Negros (as), Pessoas LGBTQIA+, Pessoas com deficiência ou Pessoas em situação de refúgio. Também reconhecemos a importância da diversidade geracional e temos orgulho em promover oportunidades para profissionais 50+, que fortalecem nosso time com suas experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, cada pessoa pode evoluir em sua jornada profissional. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento, com oportunidades de crescimento que vão de posições operacionais até cargos de liderança. Venha crescer com a gente e fazer parte dessa história! DO DISCURSO À PRÁTICA Gerenciar a operação da drogaria, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação vigente, das diretrizes corporativas e das Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas, garantindo qualidade, segurança, rentabilidade e excelência e cordialidade no atendimento ao cliente. Principais Responsabilidades Atuar como Responsável Técnico pela farmácia, garantindo o cumprimento das normas da ANVISA, CRF, Vigilância Sanitária e demais legislações aplicáveis. Assegurar a aplicação das Boas Práticas Farmacêuticas (BPF) e dos processos de garantia da qualidade. Monitorar e manter a loja preparada para auditorias, fiscalizações e inspeções sanitárias. Informar ao Gerente Regional e ao setor de Licenciamento sobre ausência ou alteração do quadro farmacêutico. Assegurar condições adequadas de armazenamento, conservação, dispensação e controle de validade dos medicamentos. Liderar, desenvolver e motivar a equipe, promovendo ambiente respeitoso, inclusivo e alinhado aos valores corporativos. Delegar tarefas e assegurar o cumprimento das atividades designadas. Conduzir reuniões periódicas e treinamentos técnicos e operacionais. Participar dos processos de admissão, promoção e desligamento em conjunto com o Gerente Regional e com aprovação da diretoria. Repassar ao time as diretrizes e comunicações oriundas da Matriz e Gerência Regional. Informar prontamente desvios de conduta ao Gerente Regional. Reportar-se ao Gerente Regional responsável pela drogaria. Atender às demandas enviadas pelos departamentos da Matriz. Responsabilizar-se pelo lançamento de atestados, afastamentos e controle de ponto no sistema. Realizar assinatura e arquivamento das folhas de ponto dos colaboradores. Acompanhar a concorrência e propor ações estratégicas para fortalecimento da unidade. Priorizar o atendimento ao cliente com cordialidade, eficiência e humanização, promovendo experiência ética e de qualidade. Realizar acompanhamento de vendas e indicadores, promovendo ações para alcance das metas. Desenvolver estratégias para aumento de ticket médio e rentabilidade da unidade. Atuar em parceria com demais áreas da loja para potencializar resultados. Requisitos Graduação em Farmácia. Registro ativo no CRF. Experiência prévia em gestão de drogarias ou varejo farmacêutico. description: Itaboraí, Brazil | Postado em 30/06/2026 Curte tecnologia, inovação e tem agilidade no DNA? Então talvez você tenha acabado de encontrar o seu próximo desafio! Na Spassu, estamos com um projeto incrível no ar — e ele está prontíssimo para receber profissionais com aquele algo a mais. Se você é Analista de Saúde Ocupacional, tem perfil inquieto, gosta de aprender e quer crescer junto com uma empresa que valoriza ideias novas, vem com a gente! Responsabilidades Apoiar a fiscalização na promoção, fiscalização e gestão da saúde ocupacional dos trabalhadores, além da análise de documentos e indicadores relacionados à segurança e saúde no ambiente de trabalho. Realizar análise técnica dos impactos de condições de trabalho na saúde dos trabalhadores e propor ações corretivas alinhadas às diretrizes do PCMSO e do Ministério da Saúde. Apoiar a fiscalização no cumprimento de requisitos legais relacionados à saúde ocupacional, como PPRA, PCMSO, ASO e CAT. Apoiar a fiscalização no levantamento, análise e disponibilização de dados de indicadores de SMS ligados à saúde, monitorando indicadores específicos de saúde ocupacional, como afastamentos por doenças, frequência de exames médicos e condições ergonômicas, e garantir a manutenção dos dados em sistemas corporativos. Atender auditorias de SMS e Gestão Ambiental, e investigações de acidentes/incidentes, com foco na saúde dos trabalhadores, analisando impactos físicos e psicológicos relacionados e propor medidas preventivas e corretivas. Fiscalizar tecnicamente contratos, garantindo que as contratadas cumpram requisitos específicos de saúde ocupacional, como realização de exames médicos periódicos e ações de promoção à saúde. Realizar Listas de Verificação (LVs) de SMS detalhadas, abrangendo conformidade com o PCMSO, ASO e outros documentos médicos relacionados à saúde dos trabalhadores. Desenvolver relatórios técnicos ou apresentações sobre SMS com foco em saúde ocupacional, incluindo análise de dados médicos, campanhas de saúde e pareceres sobre conformidade com o PCMSO e normas de saúde. Utilizar as ferramentas de gestão de Saúde e SMS da Petrobras, tais como Audicomp, SIGEM, SISPEN, SALV2, AUDICOMP, SISIN, DDSMS, DATAHIDRO, SCR, SMSNet e SIGA, para garantir o monitoramento e atualização de informações relacionadas à saúde dos trabalhadores. Avaliar e comentar documentos médicos e ocupacionais, como PCMSO, ASO e CAT, com base em conhecimentos específicos de saúde ocupacional. Participar de reuniões técnicas, elaborar minutas e pareceres técnicos sobre saúde ocupacional, incluindo indicadores de saúde, conformidade com o PCMSO e desempenho das contratadas. Garantir a aplicação de ações do PCMSO, como a realização de exames médicos ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos e demissionais) e a implementação de medidas preventivas. Acompanhar casos de afastamentos por doenças ocupacionais, realizar intervenções preventivas e propor ações corretivas para preservar a saúde dos trabalhadores. Implementar campanhas de promoção à saúde ocupacional. Requisitos Graduação em Enfermagem; Pós-Graduação lato sensu (especialização) em Enfermagem do Trabalho. Experiência Desejável: 06 anos ou mais em atividades relacionadas com atuação na indústria de energia (óleo, gás, termoelétricas, entre outras), química/petroquímica, multinacionais-certificadoras ou montagem industrial de grande ou médio porte. Além de construir empreendimentos direcionados à classe média, que possibilita a realização do sonho da casa própria a milhares de brasileiros, a empresa gera seis mil postos de trabalho por ano nos locais em que atua. Buscamos profissionais, que estejam em busca de uma oportunidade para ser protagonista de suas carreiras alavancando seus ganhos de forma autónoma. Junte-se a equipe de vendas da maior construtora da América Latina. Vem ser #sangueverde, vem ser um realizador de sonhos. Benefícios Remuneração com base em comissão sobre as vendas - Ganhos Expressivos: Comissões de até 3,5% (Ex: R$ 8.750,00 em uma única venda!). Parceria Allya - Clube de Vantagens. Treinamentos e Apoio de Plantão de Vendas. Total Pass – Plataforma de saúde e bem estar. Premiações diárias e bonificações exclusivas. Primeira venda premiada com comissão especial. Leads qualificados com potencial de vendas para você atender. Apoio Marketing com materiais e campanhas exclusivas. Primeiros clientes com análise de cpf premiado podendo chegar a 1.200,00 logo no seu início conosco. Cheque semestral podendo chegar a 25.000,00. Reembolso da anuidade do CRECI. Participação nas convenções na Sede MRV em BH, além da participação dos eventos especiais de comemoração ao Dia do Corretor. Desconto na Compra do seu 1º APÊ MRV. Apoio para retirada do CRECI ou TTI que serão explicados na entrevista. O que esperamos de você Ensino médio completo; Vivência ou interesse na área comercial e de vendas; Boa comunicação, negociação e dinamismo; Facilidade de trabalhar com ferramentas digitais; Espírito empreendedor, perfil com iniciativa e comprometimento com o negócio; Está dentro do nosso perfil? Excelente comunicação, postura profissional e organização para lidar com múltiplos processos e prazos. title: Analista de Planejamento e Controle de Manutenção (PCM)
description: Pronto para criar o seu impacto positivo? Então junte-se à Tractebel, parte do Grupo ENGIE, e aos nossos 5600 especialistas apaixonados em todo o mundo, motivados por moldar um mundo mais sustentável todos os dias. É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da aventura do século: acelerar a transição energética - ao mesmo tempo que melhora a vida das pessoas, através de projetos com significado. Dê a sua contribuição para neutralizar o carbono em mercados como de nuclear, energia, infraestrutura, saneamento e meio ambiente. Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você! O que oferecemos A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global . É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo. A empresa apoia ativamente o desenvolvimento dos seus empregados e as oportunidades de crescimento são muito amplas. Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios atrativo que inclui plano de saúde e odontológico, vale-refeição e alimentação, previdência privada, seguro de vida, wellhub, programa de incentivo de idioma e pós-graduação, além de opções de compra de ações da ENGIE. Sabemos que o equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional é fundamental para seu bem-estar. Por isso, nosso regime de trabalho é hibrido e flexível ! Você pode trabalhar de casa até 1 dia por semana e pode iniciar suas atividades entre 7h30 e 9h30 e encerrar entre 16h30 e 18h30, respectivamente. Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão . Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação. Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais. A sua missão Como Engenheiro(a) de Projetos, com foco em Planejamento e Controle da Manutenção, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias. As suas principais responsabilidades Estruturar e manter a árvore de ativos (hierarquia funcional) conforme padrão corporativo; Garantir a padronização de nomenclaturas técnicas e classificações; Gerenciar cadastro de Equipamentos, Locais de instalação, Listas técnicas (BOM), Planos e estratégias de manutenção; Assegurar a qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados no sistema (Hexagon/SAP); Implementar e monitorar governança de dados mestre (regras, auditorias, workflows); Atuar na melhoria contínua da base de dados (data cleaning, enriquecimento técnico); Desenvolver e revisar planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva; Aplicar metodologias como RCM e FMEA/FMECA; Estruturar o processo de entrada de novos ativos no sistema; Integrar dados entre CAPEX → OPEX; Definir e acompanhar KPIs de PCM; Desenvolver dashboards gerenciais; Garantir aderência aos processos e padrões corporativos. Qualificações Graduação completa em Engenharias; Conhecimento em Pacote Office; Conhecimento em Sistemas de gestão de manutenção (ex: Hexagon/SAP PM) e Gestão de ativos (ISO 55000); Conhecimento de processos industriais (ex: O&G, energia, dutos). As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força! Saiba mais sobre a Tractebel , as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós! No grupo ENGIE, cada talento tem um papel a desempenhar na aceleração da transição energética. Faça a diferença e desfrute de uma experiência profissional gratificante. Encare desafios estimulantes e construa uma trajetória de carreira que reflita quem você é. Junte-se a nós e faça parte da aventura do século! Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis, também, para candidatos com deficiência ou beneficiários reabilitados pelo INSS. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: At happn, we believe love can be as spontaneous and authentic as a real-life encounter. Thanks to our innovative real-time geolocation technology, we help singles reconnect with people who share their daily lives, habits, and favorite places. Today, happn is one of the leading dating apps in Brazil. You will be the pulse of the brand in Brazil, responsible for translating global strategy into local success. You will then lead the execution of these partnerships to expand happn's reach and boost brand credibility. Monitor and analyze social media metrics (engagement, reach, sentiment) and deliver clear, actionable reports and insights to the central marketing team. Monitor and actively moderate social media comments and discussions. You will ensure a safe and positive community environment by swiftly addressing conflicts and removing inappropriate content according to brand guidelines. Event & Brand Representation Represent happn at local events, where you will capture and create high‑quality, immediate content (photos, Reels, Stories) for real‑time social media publishing. You will also provide essential logistical and organizational support to ensure smooth execution and a strong brand presence. Market Insights Collect and relay relevant user feedback and market intelligence back to the Product and Marketing teams to inform future localization and feature development. Required Qualifications Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese with exceptional copywriting skills, a keen eye for local slang, and strong verbal communication abilities. Fluency in English (written and verbal) is mandatory for seamless collaboration, reporting, and communication with our international teams. Proven experience in a similar role, preferably within a fast‑paced B2C environment, tech, or mobile app company. Experience in local partnerships or business development is a strong plus. A genuine passion and deep interest in relationship topics, modern dating culture, and the nuances of connection in Brazil. Ability to effectively brief and collaborate with graphic designers. Willingness and availability to travel occasionally to support and capture content at local events. Highly creative, proactive, autonomous, results‑oriented, and able to represent the brand professionally and enthusiastically in all settings. Initial 3‑month trial period, with the intention of continuing the collaboration if successful. Part‑time freelance opportunity open for someone preferably based in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. Aferir e calibrar equipamentos e instrumentos, utilizando instrumentos eletrônicos de medição, coletando e registrando dados, para garantir perfeitas condições de operação e manutenção da precisão. Executar manutenção de instrumentos de processo, instrumentação analógica, digital, eletro pneumática, pneumática, eletrônica, industrial e outros, visando à sua adequada operação. Acompanhar serviços de manutenção executados por terceiros, analisando e emitindo parecer técnico sobre os mesmos. Manter equipamentos e a unidade de trabalho organizada, zelando pela sua conservação e comunicando ao superior eventuais problemas. Zelar pela conservação e guarda de ferramentas e equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade, para assegurar-lhes maior vida útil. Efetuar a limpeza do equipamento e do local de trabalho, no sentido de mantê-los em adequado estado de funcionamento com base nos 5S. Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII) , há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. title: Health & Safety Senior Consultant
description: About dss+ At dss+, you don’t just deliver projects — you help save lives, improve performance, and build a more sustainable future. We are a purpose‑led global consultancy partnering with organisations in high‑risk and asset‑intensive industries to solve complex operational challenges across safety, operational excellence, and sustainability. With a heritage rooted in DuPont’s industrial operations, we combine deep expertise, practical problem‑solving, and digital innovation to deliver measurable and lasting impact for our clients. Why This Role This role focuses on delivering high‑quality outcomes through deep expertise in operational risk management, safety, and operational improvement within the Power & Utilities sector across Latin America. You will play a key role in leading technical workstreams, solving complex operational challenges, and helping clients strengthen resilience and performance. This is an opportunity to work closely with senior client stakeholders while contributing to meaningful transformation programmes across the Latin America region. Power & Utilities – Why This Industry The Power & Utilities sector sits at the centre of the global transition to clean, reliable energy and water systems. As the industry evolves toward more distributed and dynamic models, organisations face increasing complexity and change. At dss+, we support clients to transform operations, strengthen resilience, and embed sustainable performance across their organisations. Why Operational Risk Management In a complex and fast‑changing environment, organisations must manage risk effectively to protect people, assets, and performance. At dss+, we help clients embed risk‑based decision making across their operations — integrating processes, technology, and culture to improve resilience. This enables safer, more productive operations while unlocking greater value. Key Responsibilities Lead technical or specialist workstreams within consulting engagements Deliver operational risk management, safety, and performance improvement initiatives Facilitate workshops, assessments, and stakeholder discussions with clients Analyse operational risks, systems, and improvement opportunities across industrial environments Support the design and implementation of practical and sustainable improvement solutions Mentor and support junior consultants and project teams Contribute to capability development, methodologies, and knowledge sharing across dss+ Support proposal development and client engagement activities across the region Your Impact at dss+ You will contribute to consulting engagements, supporting the delivery of transformation programmes across operational risk management. Working closely with project teams and clients, you will play a key role in analysing challenges, structuring solutions, and supporting implementation to deliver measurable impact. Key Accountabilities Support the delivery of consulting engagements across Power & Utilities projects Work on business assessments and implementation programmes, contributing to high‑quality delivery Build trusted relationships with clients, supporting senior stakeholders and account teams Participate in problem identification, analysis, and development of practical solutions Support the structuring of frameworks, methodologies, and recommendations Contribute to risk management discussions, helping identify and assess operational risks Collaborate with cross‑functional and multicultural teams across projects Stay up to date with new technologies, analytical tools, and industry trends Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery methodologies and approaches What You’ll Experience at dss+ Deliver on our Purpose Be part of a values‑led organisation where your work helps save lives, improve performance, and advance sustainability for our clients and their people. Develop your Trusted Expertise Gain early autonomy and real accountability, working closely with senior clients on complex, high‑impact challenges. Thrive in a Culture of Respect Join an inclusive and collaborative environment where your voice is valued, your curiosity is encouraged, and your wellbeing is supported. Shape your Career Accelerate your development through hands‑on experience, structured learning, and opportunities to work on international projects. Who You Are You bring strong analytical thinking, a curious mindset, and the ability to work effectively in diverse, international environments. You are comfortable engaging with stakeholders, solving complex problems, and contributing to meaningful outcomes. Experience Experience in management consulting or relevant industry environment Deep expertise in Operational Risk Management / HSE within an industrial environment Experience working with client teams and contributing to project delivery Capabilities Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills Ability to contribute to structured problem‑solving and solution development Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work in multicultural teams Adaptable and able to thrive in fast‑paced consulting environments Education & Languages Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related safety field Fluency in English required; Spanish is a plus Mobility Willingness to travel and work at client sites as required Growth & Benefits We invest in your development and success through: Structured learning and development, including our Consulting Development Academy Mentorship from experienced leaders and industry experts Opportunities to contribute to international projects Competitive salary, performance‑based incentives, and comprehensive benefits Flexible working policies A Bit More About Us We are implementers and change‑makers. Our teams work from the boardroom to the shop floor, helping organisations build resilience, improve performance, and sustain results over time. Our expertise spans industries including metals and mining, energy, chemicals, manufacturing, and private equity — combining deep operational knowledge with transformation and capability‑building expertise. Corrigir falhas, identificando a causa raiz e implementando soluções definitivas. Executar consultas em banco de dados e apoiar na movimentação de informações. Realizar deploy de aplicações e apoiar a operação dos ambientes. Monitorar sistemas, analisar logs e apoiar na resolução de incidentes. Documentar desenvolvimentos, correções e melhorias realizadas. Garantir boas práticas de segurança, versionamento e qualidade de código. Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para desenvolvimento e revisão de código. Conhecimento em lógica de programação e pelo menos uma linguagem de desenvolvimento. Noções de desenvolvimento de aplicações web (front-end e/ou back-end). Conhecimento básico em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais. Conhecimento em APIs REST e integração entre sistemas. Noções de versionamento de código utilizando Git. Conhecimento básico em Docker e pipelines de CI/CD será considerado um diferencial. Inglês técnico para leitura de documentações e mensagens de erro. Familiaridade com ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas ao desenvolvimento de software, utilizando agentes de IA para apoiar o planejamento, desenvolvimento, revisão e testes de código, com capacidade de validar e analisar criticamente os resultados. Aprendizado contínuo: demonstra curiosidade, facilidade para aprender novas tecnologias e busca constante por desenvolvimento. Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade: atua com autonomia nas atividades do dia a dia, assumindo compromisso com a qualidade das entregas e buscando melhorias contínuas. Comunicação e colaboração: comunica-se de forma clara, compartilha informações e trabalha em parceria com a equipe e as áreas de negócio para alcançar os resultados. title: Jr Project Manager
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission‑critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI‑powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well‑being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail‑oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy. You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically. Your Future at Kyndryl Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well‑rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non‑technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical And Professional Experience SCRUM or Project Management skills Organization and planning skills Bachelor's degree in IT, Networking, or Business Administration MBA or postgraduate degree in project management Availability for travel Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Advanced English MS Project or other Project Management software Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid‑friendly culture that supports your well‑being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in‑demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting‑edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands‑on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026
description: About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the NYSE (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page About The Role NuBank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual‑contributor role with organizational‑level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi‑year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization’s risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Lead organization-wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces — browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API-level integrations — across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per-authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service-to-service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. Translating least-privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization-wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization’s access risk posture over time. Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. Designing and facilitating large-scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Must-have +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid-course corrections. Expert-level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production-quality code in at least one general-purpose programming language. Demonstrated ability to model identity-related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non-technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. Nice-to-have Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third-party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open-source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. Our Benefits Chance of earning equity at Nubank Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação) Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte) NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program Life Insurance Medical Plan Dental Plan NuLanguage – Language Course Program Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses Extended Parental Leave Daycare Allowance Parental Consultancy Work-from-home Allowance Gym Partnerships 30 days of paid vacation Work Model for this Role Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Department Technical & Infrastructure Location Brazil The Position The Wayfinding and Signage Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. In all aspects of their role, they will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations, ensuring that they are managed efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. In addition, they will take guidance from other cluster managers to ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. Key Responsibilities Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. Providing expertise in assisting in the compilation of technical wayfinding signage guidelines, principles and templates. Inputting into the development of the wayfinding signage system(s) used to assist with the planning of the project. Providing strategic input into the development and implementation of the wayfinding signage kit of parts to be utilized at all official sites. Overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadiums in Brazil. Working with other Cluster Managers ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all sites within the sites. Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of allocated wayfinding operations and reporting updates to senior department members. Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaising with site owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Attending department-specific and organization site visits at both assigned sites and potentially additional official sites. Acting as the main wayfinding point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project. Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against. Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Relevant experience in delivering wayfinding and signage projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive wayfinding and signage related activities. Experience in devising technical guidelines and wayfinding signage kit of parts for large-scale events. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) Strong understanding of stadium wayfinding and signage requirements and large-scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects. Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education). Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. title: Electrical and Instrument Supervisor

Responsibilities Direct and work with Electrical / Instrument Technicians and Engineer, Electrical Technician, DCS Technician and Mechanical Engineer, Mechanical/Instrument Technician and lead the troubleshooting in electrical and instrumentation matters. Act as the FPSO Electrical Authority, reporting to the Maintenance Superintendent. Ensure that plant and equipment is fully operational and critically maintained in accordance with procedures BW and vendors, OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers) and be proactive in maintaining high Standards. Diagnose faults on defective equipment ensuring that all work is adequately monitored, carried out safely and is fit for purpose Clear reporting of deficiencies and malfunctions to the Maintenance Superintendent. Also, in the Control Systems as for ABB 800XA control system, PCS7 and WinCC Siemens control systems, GE Mark VI, Allen Bradley Controllogix5000. Discuss and analyze technical and spares issues with Maintenance Superintendent. Propose solutions related to eventual bottlenecks, deficiencies, nonconformities to Maintenance Superintendent. Review the quality of information in the maintenance database, such that the information contained is technical valid, accurate and up to date. Maintain a close working relationship with other Department Supervisors. Ensure that spare parts received for electrical and instrumentation equipment are as per material requested and revert to the Maintenance Superintendent any nonconformity in due time. Ensure compliance with permit to work system, isolation standards and Job Safety Analysis. Be aware of the financial aspects related to the maintenance of E/I equipment and give guidance to optimize the Costs Management of general housekeeping. Carry out in-house trainings to E&I personnel for power tools and hand tools. Act as Cyber Security Officer, ensuring the subject is being treated with attention and care. title: HSE Superintendent
description: The HSE Superintendent is responsible for leading Health, Safety, and Environmental activities to ensure safe and compliant offshore operations. The role supervises the HSE team, oversees regulatory compliance, emergency preparedness, incident investigations, and risk management programs. It also coordinates audits, training, permit-to-work systems, and contractor safety performance while promoting a strong safety culture. Strong leadership and continuous improvement are essential to maintaining operational excellence and HSE standards. Responsibilities Ensure safe execution of activities, enforcing compliance with statutory and company HSE requirements (NRs, API, DNV, AWS, etc.). Coordinate subcontractors and integrate HSSE plans into daily work execution. Supervise the safety team and act as a mentor to HSE staff onboard. Lead toolbox talks and ensures permits to work, JSAs, and safety documentation are properly completed. Monitor progress and prepare daily/weekly reports, including updates on safety, progress, and incidents. Provide daily HSE briefings and bi-weekly safety meetings to offshore personnel. Participate in the review of engineering documentation, shop drawings, and design specifications to ensure feasibility and constructability. Verify availability of tools, materials, consumables, and their traceability, especially for welding and specialized fabrication tasks. Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement within the FPSO team. Update IFS with maintenance/construction evidence and plan upcoming tasks in coordination with other departments. Manage non-conformities and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented. Support emergency response tasks and participate in assigned emergency duties. Serve as the main offshore focal point for implementation and compliance with HSE-MS, including SGSO, SGIP, SGSS, NR standards, and IOGP 510. Ensure alignment with ANP, IBAMA, Navy, and Labour Regulatory Agencies' requirements. Ensure full implementation of Permit to Work (PTW) systems (Hot Work, Confined Space, Working at Heights, etc.). Oversee emergency preparedness and response equipment condition, ensuring readiness and compliance. Coordinate and lead emergency drills and debriefings, ensuring compliance with ERP and OPEP. Support and coordinate fire protection measures and helideck/fire brigade operations. Lead workforce engagement programs, promoting safety culture and Stop Work authority. Lead the Incident Management. Lead incident/accident investigations and root cause analysis following corporate standards. Ensure accurate and timely reporting of incidents and near-misses, with preventive actions tracked. Submit and manage Technical Responsibility Notes (ART) as applicable. Conduct and lead Risk Assessments, Safety Cases, and job-specific hazard analysis. Develop and follow up on HSE Action Plans. Lead internal inspections and audits; support external audits. Promote continual improvement initiatives to reduce operational risks and improve safety systems. Monitor safety practices and performance of third-party contractors. Maintain updated documentation and records for all HSE processes onboard. Prepare and submit daily and monthly HSE reports to onshore teams. Manage PPE inventory and calibrate gas detection equipment. Support lab safety documentation and digital file maintenance in cooperation with onshore support. Education Bachelor’s degree in engineering. A postgraduate degree in Safety Engineering is desirable. Safety Technician is acceptable with more than 15years experience. Experience Minimum 10 years in offshore Oil & Gas industry. Experience on FPSO or production platforms preferred. Proven background in HSE leadership roles and in multi-cultural environments. Languages: Portuguese and English (Fluent; ability to communicate on technical aspects) Knowledge Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Assertive decision-making and problem-solving under pressure. High level of accountability, integrity, and flexibility. Analytical thinking and detail-oriented approach. Proactive safety leadership and coaching abilities. Capability to influence and engage with cross-functional teams. Offshore-based position with 100% time on board. Requires certification and compliance with NR-35 (Work at Height) and confined space entry. Emergency role responsibilities as defined in the ERP #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Carbon Markets & Climate Finance Specialist
description: Job Description As part of the expansion of our investment platform in Brazil, we are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Carbon Credit Specialist to join our Investment Management team in Rio de Janeiro. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in the development of one of Latin America’s most promising carbon investment platforms, supporting investments across sustainable agriculture, forestry, timber, nature-based solutions, land restoration, eco-tourism, renewable energy, and broader decarbonization sectors. The successful candidate will serve as the in-house expert on carbon markets and carbon finance, supporting the origination, evaluation, structuring, execution, and ongoing management of carbon-credit-related investment opportunities. Working closely with investment professionals, project developers, legal advisors, and international investors, the Carbon Credit Specialist will help ensure that carbon-related value creation opportunities are effectively integrated into both debt and equity investment transactions. The role combines technical carbon market expertise, transaction experience, financial analysis, regulatory understanding, and strategic thinking. It offers significant exposure to both domestic and international carbon markets and the opportunity to contribute to innovative climate-finance solutions with measurable environmental and social impact. English is the company’s working language but (Brazilian) Portuguese is required in the local context. Key Responsibilities Carbon Investment Origination and Evaluation Identify and assess carbon-credit-related opportunities within prospective debt and equity investments. Evaluate the commercial viability of carbon projects and carbon revenue streams across sectors including forestry, regenerative agriculture, sustainable land use, renewable energy, and other decarbonization activities. Analyze project eligibility under major voluntary and compliance carbon market standards and frameworks. Transaction Structuring and Execution Support the structuring and execution of investments involving carbon-credit generation, ownership, monetization, and delivery mechanisms. Advise investment teams on integrating carbon credit economics into investment underwriting and valuation models. Contribute to transaction due diligence processes, including the assessment of carbon-related risks, opportunities, and compliance requirements. Coordinate with legal, tax, technical, and external advisory parties throughout transaction execution. Carbon Markets and Regulatory Analysis Monitor developments in Brazilian and international carbon markets, including voluntary and emerging compliance frameworks. Analyze regulatory, legal, tax, and policy developments affecting carbon project development, carbon credit transfers, and international credit commercialization. Provide strategic guidance on carbon market trends, pricing dynamics, market integrity considerations, and evolving industry standards. Portfolio Management and Monitoring Support the monitoring and management of carbon-credit-generating investments throughout the investment lifecycle. Track project performance, verification milestones, issuance schedules, and compliance requirements. Identify value optimization opportunities and potential risks related to carbon-credit generation and commercialization. Investor Reporting and Stakeholder Management Prepare high-quality investment memoranda, market analyses, and reporting materials for domestic and international investors. Communicate carbon-related investment performance, market developments, and portfolio outcomes to investors and stakeholders. Represent the organization in discussions with project developers, registries, certification bodies, consultants, and market participants. What we expect Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Forestry, Agriculture, Mathematics, Climate Studies, or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in carbon markets, carbon project development, carbon finance, climate finance, environmental markets, or a related field. Demonstrated experience in evaluating, structuring, and executing carbon-credit-related transactions. Strong understanding of voluntary carbon markets and emerging compliance market frameworks. Knowledge of carbon accounting methodologies, project certification processes, registries, and credit issuance procedures. Solid understanding of the regulatory and tax considerations associated with carbon credit generation, transfer, and commercialization. Experience supporting investment transactions, due diligence exercises, or project-finance activities. Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Portuguese. We value diversity and inclusion and highly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment. What you can expect An agile, widely diverse international working environment with employees of 68 nationalities that is keenly interested in making a positive difference through their work and who share a collaborative, can-do spirit. A company that is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive, contribute, and grow. A job that allows you to fully utilize and expand your skills within an innovative, hands-on company culture. A purpose-driven, performance-oriented company that rewards above-average results. An organization dedicated to providing effective training and upskilling to its employees. A company that offers a flexible and amicable work environment, placing a high value on work-life balance. We, a team of over 300 dedicated professionals across 16 regional offices worldwide, are committed to advancing sustainable development through pioneering finance solutions. If you relish tackling complex challenges hands-on and crave an adaptable and motivating work environment, we’re eager to connect with you. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Open Call: Itinera Arte International Artist Residency Program — Expanded Field Performance Art, Film, Art, Photography, Others Description Entitled Expanded Field, the 3rd cycle of Itinera Arte's International Artist Residency Program proposes a critical and sensitive investigation into practices that take shape at the intersection of languages, media, and regimes of visibility. The title directly evokes the notion of the "expanded field" formulated by Rosalind Krauss in her seminal essay Sculpture in the Expanded Field (1979), identifying the collapse of traditional categories of sculpture and the emergence of practices operating within an expanded territory. The program welcomes artists whose research challenges stable disciplinary categories, shifting the boundaries between painting, sculpture, photography, performance, video, sound, writing, and other hybrid practices that resist conventional classifications. Artists who wish to use the residency to reinvent their poetics through experimentation with new media and materials are also encouraged to apply. This cycle additionally proposes thinking of the expanded field beyond a strictly linguistic dimension -- articulating it with geographic and symbolic expansion, and investigating how contemporary artistic practices relate to multiple territorialities, questioning notions of belonging, displacement, and borders. 10 artists will be selected. The residency runs from October 5 to November 30, 2026, in downtown Rio de Janeiro, coordinated by curators Thiago Fernandes and João Paulo Ovídio. Each selected artist receives: Studio space in downtown Rio de Janeiro (25 m²), equipped with a work table, in individual or shared format Weekly curatorial guidance with the program's curators Portfolio reviews and critical follow-up on works developed during the residency Conversations with invited curators, artists, and art professionals Studio visits, gallery and institution visits, and engagement with the local art scene Cultural activities in the central region of Rio de Janeiro Institutional promotion through Itinera Arte's communication channels A collective exhibition and open studio at the end of the residency Eligible Locations Global Open to artists internationally. Applicants must be able to communicate in Portuguese or English, and all application materials must be submitted in one of these two languages.
